title: Hall of Presidents Wax Museum Colorado Springs Brochure 1975 Josephine Tussaud
conditionDescription: Vintage tri-fold brochure. Handwritten date "Aug 1975" on one inside panel; normal fold lines, bright color.
descriptionText:
Vintage Hall of Presidents Wax Museum tri-fold brochure, 1050 South 21st, Colorado Springs, Colorado. Dated by hand: Aug 1975.

- Over 100 life-size wax figures by Josephine Tussaud (World of Wax)
- Color photos: Washington Crossing the Delaware, Lincoln on his Statue Chair, Churchill and Roosevelt, the Court of Versailles, Kennedy and the Astronauts, Andrew Jackson's Victory Celebration, Fairyland's Mad Hatter tea party and the Rabbit Warren
- Illustrated pictorial map of Colorado Springs and Pikes Peak: Manitou Springs, Garden of the Gods, Cave of the Winds, Cripple Creek, Van Briggle Pottery, Ghost Town and more

Condition: used. Normal fold lines and bright color; someone wrote "Aug 1975" on one inside panel (see photos).

Please see all photos - they are part of the description.
